hookups.source: Hipcamp listing (the operator's booking channel): sites 'RV site #12 pull-thru 30 amp', '#18 back-in 30 amp', '#14 back-in 30 amp', overview 'a gravel drive thru space with a camp style grill, picnic table, fire-pit, power and water hookups. However we do have a a dump-station on site free for our guests to use.', read 2026-10-29

values.note: 4 RV sites: #12 pull-through 45 ft, #14 back-in 25 ft, #18 back-in 26 ft (all 30 A water/electric), #20 30 ft (no hookups listed). Also 2 tent platforms, 2 primitive tent sites, 2 A-frames and a furnished on-site RV.

sites.source: Hipcamp listing sites (rvMaxLength 45/25/26/30 ft, accessType DRIVE_IN, TWO_WHEEL_DRIVE; 'rvCount 4') + https://www.pineyhillscampground.com/offerings (A-Frames, platforms, primitive, on-site RV, RV sites), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://www.pineyhillscampground.com/ ('Hot showers', 'Coin operated washers/dryers', 'Flushable toilets', 'FREE WiFi') + Hipcamp site overview ('a dump-station on site free for our guests to use'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 30 A RV sites list at $38 a night and show $36.10 on Hipcamp; RV site 20 (no hookups listed) lists at $48, shows $38.40. The operator offers 10% off any site Sunday-Thursday. Hipcamp adds its own service fee.

fees.source: Hipcamp listing sites (pricePerNightBase $38.00 / pricePerNight $36.10 for #12, #14, #18; $48.00 / $38.40 for site 20) + https://www.pineyhillscampground.com/ ('Receive 10% off any site on weekdays Sunday- Thursday'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: The operator's BOOK NOW buttons go to Hipcamp (instant book); otherwise call 478-227-6006. Long-term rates by arrangement.

booking.source: https://www.pineyhillscampground.com/offerings (every BOOK NOW links to the Hipcamp listing; 'Long term rates available'; 'If you don't see the site you're looking for, give us a Call') + Hipcamp sites (isInstantBookable true, maxNights 29), read 2026-10-29

note: Small farm-stay campground near Mauk (348 Averett Rd): farm animals, 60+ acres of hiking/bike trails, golf-cart rentals, propane refills, gated entrance. Hipcamp 'Best in State' 2025. --Claude
summary: Operator site + its Hipcamp booking listing: 4 RV sites (30 A water/electric at three; pull-through #12 to 45 ft, back-ins 25-26 ft; site 20 30 ft), no sewer (dump station), showers/flush toilets/laundry/WiFi, $36.10-38 a night for 30 A sites ($48 list for site 20), Hipcamp instant book, 29-night max. Note trimmed of hookups/lengths/booking/RV Life text. Google: 4.7 stars / 30 reviews, phone 478-227-6006 matches. Under the gate.
